Accomplishment
1. Founded Acuta Capital Partners, with over $600 million AUM at the time of his death

2. Seed investor in Calistoga (acquired by Gilead), which developed a Pi3k inhibitor that is now approved to treat NHL, CLL and Follicular Lymphoma and in Acerta Pharma B.V. (acquired by Astra Zeneca), which developed a BTK inhibitor that is now approved to treat Mantle Cell Lymphoma

3. Howard Hughes Scholar at the National Institutes of Health; Therapeutic Advisory Council for Harvard Medical School; Arjay Miller Scholar and faculty at Stanford Graduate School of Business

4. World Series of Poker player
